SELECT 
    player_name,
    CASE WHEN team_side = 'home' THEN
        CASE WHEN match_type = 'home_win' THEN 'win'
             ELSE 'loss' END
     ELSE
        CASE WHEN match_type = 'away_win' THEN 'win'
             ELSE 'loss' END END as result,
    COUNT(*) as count
FROM (SELECT * FROM unpivot_home UNION ALL SELECT * FROM unpivot_away) as all_players
GROUP BY player_name, result
ORDER BY result, count DESC
LIMIT 3
